measures.name: Revenue
measures.description: Item prices excluding freight, across all order statuses in the current sales-item selection.

measures.name: Freight Revenue
measures.description: Freight charged on selected sales items; this is not freight profit.

measures.name: Total Order Value
measures.description: Item prices plus freight for selected sales items; not a payment reconciliation measure.

measures.name: Orders
measures.description: Distinct orders with sales items in the current selection. Orders without items are excluded.

measures.name: Units Sold
measures.description: Sales-item rows in the current selection, including all order statuses.

measures.name: Customers
measures.description: Distinct people with selected sales items, using the persistent customer_unique_id. Respects date, product, customer and order filters.

measures.name: AOV
measures.description: Average selected merchandise value per order, excluding freight. Returns zero when there are no orders.

measures.name: AOV Including Freight
measures.description: Average selected item value plus freight per order. Returns zero when there are no orders.

measures.name: Units per Order
measures.description: Average selected sales-item count per order. Returns zero when there are no orders.

measures.name: Revenue per Customer
measures.description: Selected merchandise revenue per distinct person, excluding freight.

measures.name: Repeat Customers
measures.description: People with more than one distinct order within the current selection, not lifetime repeat buyers.

measures.name: Repeat Customer Rate
measures.description: Share of customers with more than one selected order. Returns zero for an empty selection.

measures.name: Revenue PY
measures.description: Revenue over the selected calendar dates shifted back one year. Blank for selections spanning multiple years or absent prior data. Use DimDate for date slicing.

measures.name: YoY Revenue Change
measures.description: Selected revenue minus prior-year comparable-date revenue; blank without a comparison.
measures.expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Revenue]) && NOT ISBLANK([Revenue PY]), [Revenue] - [Revenue PY])

measures.name: YoY Revenue Growth %
measures.description: Revenue change divided by prior-year revenue; blank for missing or zero baselines. Incomplete periods must be disclosed.

measures.name: Delivered Orders
measures.description: Distinct delivered orders with selected sales items, counted once per order.

measures.name: Delivery Eligible Orders
measures.description: Delivered orders with both actual and estimated delivery dates, used as the late-rate denominator.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Orders), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(FactSales[OrderID]), Orders[order_id])), KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "delivered"), FILTER(Orders, NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) && NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_estimated_delivery_date])))

measures.name: Late Orders
measures.description: Eligible orders arriving after the estimated calendar date. Same-day arrival is on time.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Orders), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(FactSales[OrderID]), Orders[order_id])), KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "delivered"), FILTER(Orders, NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) && NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_estimated_delivery_date]) && INT(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) > INT(Orders[order_estimated_delivery_date])))

measures.name: Late Delivery Rate
measures.description: Late orders / eligible delivered orders; blank when no eligible deliveries exist.
measures.expression: IF([Delivery Eligible Orders] > 0, DIVIDE(COALESCE([Late Orders], 0), [Delivery Eligible Orders]))

measures.name: Average Delivery Days
measures.description: Mean calendar days from purchase to actual delivery, one observation per delivered order. Missing or negative durations excluded.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(FILTER(Orders, NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_purchase_timestamp]) && NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) && Orders[order_delivered_customer_date] >= Orders[order_purchase_timestamp]), DATEDIFF(Orders[order_purchase_timestamp], Orders[order_delivered_customer_date], DAY)), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(FactSales[OrderID]), Orders[order_id])), KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "delivered"))

measures.name: Reviewed Orders
measures.description: Selected orders with at least one valid 1–5 review score.

measures.name: Average Review Score
measures.description: Mean of each selected order’s mean valid review score. Equal weight per order prevents multiple responses or sales items overweighting an order.
